podcast.body: One of the four singles released from the debut album Hybrid Theory. A live recording of "Papercut" was made at the Docklands Arena in London for the BBC, and this version was subsequently included on a bonus disc accompanying the special two-disc Japanese edition of the *Hybrid Theory* album. "It's a version of PaperCut recorded of the Docklands Arena in London for the BBC."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released as a single from the *Hybrid Theory* album, this song followed "Crawling." "It was followed by Paper Cut"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was identified as one of three Linkin Park tracks that influenced 15-year-old Charles Andrew Williams before his shooting spree at Santana High School on March 5, 2001. "Williams had been influenced by three different Lincoln Park songs, Papercut, One Step Closer, and In The End."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
